title: Emulator rewind and live-host authority are separate
summary: Journal-pointed state, retained-branch time travel, exact execution tickets and retry orchestration apply only to EMULATOR, TESTBED and REPLAY_SANDBOX state. They are not authority to rewind IBM i or bypass live session ownership, WLU, credential or NONDISPLAY boundaries.
invariants: Patchability is explicit; method-shaped objects are insufficient.
Execution tickets are exact-object capabilities and are not exposed to instruction/event handlers.
Failed speculative attempts roll back emulator state while retaining value-free debugger evidence.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
